primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: アヒオとともに箱を載せた車を運転したウザを明記。
primaryTextRead.text: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 直前に運転者として名が挙がるウザの行動を記す。
primaryTextRead.text: When they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: ウザに起きた出来事を名指しで記す。
primaryTextRead.text: The LORD’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 直前の出来事を受け、ダビデの反応と場所名を記す。
primaryTextRead.text: David was displeased, because the LORD had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.

wikipediaRead.title: Uzzah
wikipediaRead.locator: L122–125. L122 identifies Uzzah/Uzza and cites 1 Chronicles 13:7–11; L123 names Ahio as his brother and says they drove the cart.
wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: 記事は13:7の車を運転したウザを特定し、該当箇所を直接挙げる。
wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: 対象節・人物名・同行者の記述が一致する。別人のメラリ族ウザはL136で別記。

sourceReuse: All pinned WEB passages and any linked article body checked for this 1CH identity; no prior profile text copied.
